style: Same dark-gold brand system as pricing-tiers-reveal / revenue-math-reveal: near-black stage, League Gothic condensed display numerals/headlines, Montserrat supporting labels, gold accent + bright-gold emphasis. A two-beat contrast piece: first a literal 'one lead becomes many' split diagram, then a hard kinetic-type flip from a trust question to a price question, landing on a value line.

customize.note: Hand-authored, following the exact CSS/GSAP patterns established in pricing-tiers-reveal/index.html and revenue-math-reveal/index.html (bg-fill full-bleed reveal, card-glow radial, tabular numerals, proxy-object count-ups, freeze-hold ending). Catalog searched for 'card duplicate clone stagger fan out', 'text swap strikethrough cross out replace', and 'connecting line draw between nodes' — reused the strikethrough-replace component's technique (scaleX strike-line draw + fade-in replacement) and the SVG pathLength=1 / stroke-dashoffset line-draw technique as hand-authored GSAP recipes rather than importing the components verbatim, since the sibling projects in this series are themselves fully hand-authored single-file compositions (no literal `hyperframes add` blocks) and this shot needs bespoke multi-part staging (homeowner card, 4 contractor slots, traveling clone icons, connector lines) that no single catalog block covers wholesale.

scenes.text: SHARED LEAD PLATFORMS / HOMEADVISOR · ANGIE'S · THUMBTACK
scenes.motion: eyebrow fade_in, three chips stagger in with scale_punch (back.out)

scenes.text: 1 HOMEOWNER LEAD → CONTRACTOR A / B / C / D — THE SAME LEAD. SOLD TO EVERYONE.

scenes.text: WHO CAN I TRUST? → WHO'S THE CHEAPEST? / WHEN THEY ONLY SEE A NUMBER, THEY DON'T SEE YOUR VALUE.

scenes.motion: old question fade_blur in (muted), strike-through line draws across it, group fades out; new question scale_punch in huge + bright gold (back.out) with a glow pulse — the dominant motif of the whole piece; closing line fade_in beneath; freeze-hold to the end for a clean cut back to host footage
